records.question: Lee is saving up for a new pair of sneakers which cost $90. He already has $15 saved. He plans to sell his old action figures to make the rest. If he sells 10 action figures and still has $25 left after buying the sneakers how much did he charge per action figure?
records.response:
Lee needs to save an additional $90 - $15 = $75 to buy the sneakers.
He sells 10 action figures and has $25 left, meaning he sold 75 - 25 = $50 worth of action figures.
Therefore, he charged $50 / 10 = $5 per action figure.

records.question: Donny went to the gas station to gas up his tank. He knows his truck holds 150 liters of fuel. His truck already contained 38 liters. How much change will he get from $350 if each liter of fuel costs $3?
records.response:
Donny needs to fill up 150-38 = 112 liters.
He will spend 112*3 = $336.
He will get 350-336 = $14 in change.
